name: derma-ai
description: DermaAI - Multimodal AI Skin Disease Diagnosis & Severity Prediction (final-year project)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n ML,SERVER,CLIENT -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
